questions.question: If 9 # 3 = 6; 15 # 3 = 9; 60 # 4 = 32; then what is the value of 27 # 3 = ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is that both the numbers are added and result is divided by 2

9 # 3 = 6

→ (9 + 3) ÷ 2 = 6

15 # 3 = 9

→ (15 + 3) ÷ 2 = 9

60 # 4 = 32

→ (60 + 4) ÷ 2 = 32

Similarly;

27 # 3 = ?

→ (27 + 3) ÷ 2 = 15

Hence, the correct answer is 15.

questions.question: Aarush's birthday is on Thursday 27th April. On what day of the week will be Mitul's birthday in the same year if Mitul was born on 28th September?
questions.solution:
27th April Thursday (Aarush’s birthday)

Number of days between 27th April and 28th September

= 3 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 28 → 154

Number of odd days = 154/7 → 0 (odd days)

Day on Mitul’s birthday = 28th September

→ Thursday + 0 = Thursday

Hence, Mitul’s birthday is on Thursday.

questions.question: If a³ + b³ = 341 and ab = 30, then what is the value of a + b?
questions.solution:
We know that

a³ + b³ + 3ab (a + b) = (a + b) ³ ----(1)

Given that, a³ + b³ = 341 and ab = 30

So, putting these values in equation (1), we get

341 + 3 × 30 (a + b) = (a + b)³ ----(2)

Putting the value of (a + b) from options in equation (2), we get

341 + 90 × 1 = 1³

⇒ 431 ≠ 1

So, a + b ≠ 1

Again, 341 + 90 × 9 = 9³

⇒ 1151 ≠ 729

So, a + b ≠ 9

Again, 341 + 90 × 7 = 7³

⇒ 971 ≠ 343

So, a + b ≠ l7

Again, 341 + 90 × 11 = 11³

⇒ 1331 = 1331

∴ a + b = 11

questions.question: What is the reflection of the point (-4, 3) in the line x = -2?
questions.solution:
Reflection of any point on the same side of an axis is always 0 because its distance would be parallel to its previous position.

Here (-4, 3) is reflected at x = -2 so x coordinates will be 0 because reflection will not occur and

Reflection of any point on opposite axis will always be same in magnitude because distance is same from both the points horizontally.

Hence reflection of y = 3 at x = -2 point will be = 3

∴ Reflection of point (-4, 3) at x = -2 is (0, 3)

questions.question: If 1 shirt is offered free on purchase of 4 shirts, what is the effective discount (in %) on each shirt?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

1 shirt is free with every 4 shirts.

**Calculation:**

Suppose marked price of each shirt = Rs.100

Discount on 4 shirts = C.P of one shirt

Here we assume that C.P = M.P

Total Cost price of 4 shirts = 4 × 100 = Rs. 400

It means the buyer has got 5 shirts at the cost price of 4 shirts

So Discount = 500 - 400 = Rs.100

Discount % = Discount/M.P × 100 = frac{{100}}{{500}} times 100 = 20{{\% }}

∴ 20% effective discount was offered on the shirts

questions.question: When a number is increased by 69, it becomes 103% of itself. What is the number?

⇒ 6900 = 1030x - 1000x

⇒ 30x = 6900

⇒ x = 230

∴ The required number is 10 × 230 = 2300

questions.question: What is the slope of the line parallel to the line passing through the points (3, -4) and (-2, 5)?

questions.question: What is the sum of the first 13 terms of an arithmetic progression if the 5th term is 1 and the 8th term is -17?
questions.solution:
We know that,

Nth term of an A.P = aₙ = a + (n - 1) d

⇒ a₅ = a + (5 - 1) d

⇒ a + 4d = 1 ----(i)

⇒ a₈ = a + (8 - 1) d

⇒ a + 7d = -17 ----(ii)

Eq (ii) - Eq(i)

⇒ 3d = -18

⇒ d = -6

From eq i

a + 4 × (-6) = 1

⇒ a = 1 + 24

⇒ a = 25

So,

Sum of 13 terms of an AP is given by

Sₙ = n/2 × [2a + (n - 1) d]

⇒ 13/2 × [2 × 25 + (13 - 1) (-6)]

⇒ 13/2[50 - 72]

⇒ frac{{13}}{2} times ( { - 22} )

⇒ -143

∴ Sum of first 13 terms of an A.P is -143

questions.question: ΔXYZ is similar to ΔPQR. If ratio of Perimeter of ΔXYZ and Perimeter of ΔPQR is 4 : 9 and if PQ = 27 cm, then what is the length of XY (in cm)?

Given that ΔXYZ is similar to ΔPQR

Since they are similar we know,

(Perimeter of ∆XYZ)/(perimeter of ∆PQR) = (length of XY)/(length of PQ)

Ratio of Perimeter of ΔXYZ and Perimeter of ΔPQR is 4 : 9

⇒ 4/9 = (length of XY)/27

⇒ Length of XY = 4/9 × 27= 12 cm

∴ Length of XY is 12 cm

questions.question: A and B together do a job in 12 days and A could do the job in 20 days if he worked alone. How many days would B take to do the job if he worked alone?
questions.solution:
Let the total work = 60 units

Efficiency of A + B = 60 / 12 = 5 units /day

Efficiency of A = 60 / 20 = 3 units /day

So, Efficiency of B = total efficiency of (A + B) - efficiency of A = 5 - 3 = 2 units/day

⇒ Total time taken by B alone = 60 / 2 = 30 days

∴ B take 30 days to do the work alone

questions.question: The average marks of 40 students in an examination were 34. It was later found that the marks of one student had been wrongly entered as 62 instead of 26. What is the correct average?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average marks of 40 students in an examination were 34

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of all the terms/Total number of terms

**Calculation:**

Sum of total marks of students in an examination = 40 × 34 = 1360

Sum of correct total marks of students in an examination = 40 × 34 = 1360 + 26 - 62 = 1324

Correct average = (1324)/40 = 33.1

**∴ The Correct average is 33.1**

questions.question: The ratio of present ages of P and Q is 7 : 9. Before 10 years the ratio of their ages was 5 : 7. What is Q's present age (in years)?
questions.solution:
Let the present ages of P and Q be 7x and 9x respectively

According to the question,

(7x - 10) / (9x - 10) = 5/7

⇒ 7(7x - 10) = 5 (9x - 10)

⇒ 49x - 70 = 45x - 50

⇒ 20 = 4x

⇒ x = 5

Present age of Q = 9x = 9 × 5 = 45 years

∴ Present age of Q is 45 years

questions.question: Point A divides segment BC in the ratio 5 : 1. Co-ordinates of B are (6,-4) and C are (0, 8). What are the co-ordinates of point A?

Coordinates of point C = (0, 8) as (x₂, y₂)

m₁ ∶ m₂ = 5 ∶ 1

x = (m₁x₂ + m₂x₁)/(m₁ + m₂), y = (m₁y₂ + m₂y₁)/(m₁ + m₂)

x = (5 × 0 + 1 × 6)/(5 +1) = 6/6 = 1

y = (5 × 8 + 1 ×(-4))/(5 +1) = (40 - 4)/6 = 36/6 = 6

∴ The coordinates of point A is (1, 6)

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect speech. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Indirect/Direct speech.**

"How old is your grandmother?", Navneet asked her.

options.text: Navneet asked her how old her grandmother is.
Navneet asked her how old her grandmother has been.
Navneet asked her how old her grandmother was.
Navneet asked her how old is her grandmother.

questions.solution:
Correct answer: Navneet asked her how old her grandmother was.

Direct speech describes when something is being repeated exactly as it was, usually in between a pair of inverted commas. Indirect speech is a report on what someone else said or wrote without using that person's exact words. Here, the correct answer is, Navneet asked her how old her grandmother was. We can see how in the mentioned solution, the actions of Navneet are being reported.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select "no improvement".**

Rahul went out without (saying) goodbye.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'No improvement'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the usage of 'saying' is absolutely correct.
 
• According to grammar, whenever we use a preposition we need to use a prepositional object after it and a prepositional object can be a noun/noun clause/noun phrase/pronoun/gerund. 
 
• In the given sentence, a gerund is mentioned i.e. 'saying'
 
• Let's see some examples-
 
 
• I put the pizza **on the table. (on the table (the table is a noun))**
 
• In the afternoon the snow pelted Raymond **on his little bald head. (His little bald head is a noun phrase)**
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4 i.e. No improvement.**
